flyer.justification: The flyer captures the core message and logistics well, though the title exceeds the 6-word limit requirement.

instagram.justification: The post perfectly follows all format instructions including carousel visual cues, engaging copy, emojis, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: The summary provides an exceptional, highly structured executive briefing with key metrics from the talk and stays well under the 400-word limit.

linkedin.justification: The LinkedIn draft is cleanly written with clear insights, avoids forbidden buzzwords, and includes an engaging closing question with 5 relevant hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter adheres strictly to formatting guidelines with a subject line under 50 characters, three bold subheadings, and a conversational tone.

blog.justification: The blog post is comprehensive and thoroughly covers the transcript's key arguments, incorporating all requested markdown elements and an author bio.
